item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Jaafar Jackson - Famous (M4A)
item.description:
Can someone please upload Jaafar Jackson's planned album Famous in M4A? It includes these songs:

Adam's Eve
Zion
Where Are You
Rêverie
Famous
Lay Down
French Riviera
Ready For You
Night Rider
Got Me Singing
Confused
Universe of Love (mistaken for Rebirth of Michael)
You're The One

He never got to release this album but he did release Got Me Singing (and Confused, at some point)
item.author: carmesim
